scope: Installed Codex backend/CLI inventory and synthetic protocol experiments; frontend paint is a separate evidence layer.
proof_path_rule: Proof paths are relative to artifact_root unless they begin with evaluations/, which is repository-relative.

versions.ide_extension: untested; no code command or standard user extension directory was found in the bounded inventory

baseline_replay.retained_failure: The old assertion expects nested-schema error -32601; the desktop core returns -32602. All three original failing reports are preserved.

features.surface: Both installed app-server stdio cores; CLI JSON fallback has separate historical evidence
features.offering: MCP text, structuredContent and private result metadata can travel together.
features.evidence: observed-working; direct synthetic tool results in both current binaries
features.limits: Receipt does not establish a card, iframe, native form or model interpretation.

features.surface: npm CLI and desktop-bundled executable
features.offering: Installed exec help exposes noninteractive JSON events, schema-constrained final output, output-file options and image attachments; interactive CLI has its own TUI.
features.evidence: observed-working help inventory; documented interface; current model execution untested
features.limits: JSON event serialization and a model output schema are data contracts. They do not provide an HTML renderer.

features.surface: Fresh isolated model/list responses
features.offering: The npm catalog defaults to gpt-5.6-sol; the desktop-bundled catalog defaults to gpt-6.1-sol. The sampled entries advertise text/image input modalities.
features.evidence: observed-working zero-inference catalog requests; conditional account entitlement
features.limits: Catalog defaults are not an account inference entitlement test. A model ID or image modality does not grant a UI surface. The synthetic app-server metadata source value vscode is not evidence of an actual IDE frontend.

features.surface: Codex in ChatGPT desktop; Codex CLI plugin browser; IDE extension
features.offering: Official docs describe plugin bundles with skills, MCP servers, optional UI and other capabilities on supported desktop/CLI surfaces.
features.evidence: documented; IDE plugin-bundle availability explicitly excluded by current docs; package installation not repeated here
features.limits: The IDE plugin-bundle exclusion does not exclude separately configured MCP servers or tools in the IDE.

features.surface: Desktop, CLI and IDE configuration; tested backend uses stdio
features.offering: Official same-host configuration supports local stdio and Streamable HTTP, with transport-specific environment/authentication options and tool policy.
features.evidence: observed-working stdio fixture; documented HTTP and shared-surface setup
features.limits: HTTP/OAuth, remote executors and IDE installation were not exercised. No global configuration was changed.

features.surface: Direct app-server MCP tool/resource calls
features.offering: HTML app MIME, ui:// resources and _meta.ui.resourceUri survive transport; SVG and CSV resources can also be read.
features.evidence: observed-working bytes and metadata in both cores
features.limits: The HTML script marker exists in delivered bytes. No script execution or frontend resource fetch is established by the backend test.

features.surface: Isolated app-server JSON-RPC connection
features.offering: A custom client can receive tool/resource data and implement its own frontend. Actual desktop MCP App rendering is a distinct host bridge.
features.evidence: observed-failed ui/initialize at this wrong app-server endpoint; observed-working resource transport; frontend paint untested in this study
features.limits: Neither schema has ui/* or fullscreen/sidebar/canvas placement method names in its client-request union. This absence does not exclude supported plugin UI in the desktop frontend.

features.surface: Fresh isolated effective feature flags in both cores
features.offering: features list reports enable_mcp_apps as under development and false. A per-process true override was tested without editing global settings.
features.evidence: observed-working override and existing contracts; no additional UI extension advertisement observed
features.limits: The override did not advertise io.modelcontextprotocol/ui in these fixture connections. It is not a general recipe for enabling desktop paint or proof of its absence.

features.surface: MCP elicitation through app-server, on-request policy
features.offering: Synthetic string, bounded integer, boolean, single enum and enumerated string-array schemas reached the client; accept, decline and cancel responses reached the MCP server.
features.evidence: observed-working protocol callbacks and synthetic responses in both cores
features.limits: The study did not render controls or verify screen-reader, keyboard, focus or native form pixels.

features.surface: App-server approvalPolicy never versus on-request
features.offering: on-request forwards elicitation callbacks. never auto-declines the same synthetic form requests without forwarding a form callback.
features.evidence: observed-working policy-specific fallback; observed-failed presentation opportunity under never
features.limits: These results concern elicitation policy; they do not prove a command/file approval UI or a global permission bypass.

features.surface: MCP form opt-in and actual tool-serving process
features.offering: PID-correlated initialization shows the process serving direct tools advertises openai/form when opted in. Flat openai/form and openaiForm requests normalize to ordinary form, including without opt-in.
features.evidence: observed-working capability correlation and flat normalization; observed-failed arbitrary nested schema
features.limits: The nested invalid fixture returns -32601 on 0.145.0 and -32602 on 0.164.0-alpha.11.1. It is not a valid image-picker acceptance test. Documented richer native forms and thumbnails remain untested. Prior attribution to a non-advertising executing thread connection was unsupported by the old logs and should be withdrawn.

features.surface: Generated server-request schemas and official app-server docs
features.offering: Server requests cover command execution, file changes, user questions, MCP elicitation and additional permission approval.
features.evidence: observed-working schema generation; documented decision payloads; actual command/file approval presentation untested
features.limits: A request schema is not a rendered prompt. Device user-verification mode in the new schema was not invoked.

features.surface: MCP output; CLI/model input catalogs
features.offering: PNG result content survives the baseline replay, while help/catalogs separately expose image input paths.
features.evidence: observed-working one-pixel PNG transport; documented and inventoried input interface
features.limits: A transport pixel is not a meaningful model-vision test, image-generation test, terminal image display or interactive canvas.

features.surface: Isolated installed feature inventories
features.offering: Both inventories report stable enabled apps, plugins, image_generation and in_app_browser flags; the newer core also lists in-app chat, dictation and voice flags.
features.evidence: observed-working feature inventory; actual generation, browser and voice behavior untested in this study
features.limits: An enabled flag does not establish model entitlement, a callable plugin surface, a visible image viewer or media rendering. No image-generation or browser automation model turn was spent.

features.surface: Synthetic MCP result content through both cores
features.offering: Audio content carries a valid 80-frame 8kHz PCM WAV; resource_link carries CSV metadata; embedded resource carries SVG text.
features.evidence: observed-working typed transport and WAV byte decoding
features.limits: No audio playback, transcription, SVG native paint, OS download, camera/microphone permission or video decoder was tested. Invalid custom MCP content variants return -32603 Unexpected response type.

features.surface: Direct mcpServer/tool/call without a model turn
features.offering: A synthetic server state can move from value/version 0 to 1; stale writes return isError while preserving value/version 1. The progress tool's final result arrives.
features.evidence: observed-working versioned state and final result; progress notification forwarding unobserved in this route
features.limits: No app-server progress event was seen for these direct calls. In-turn item streaming and actual progress widgets are separate tests; their absence is not inferred.

features.surface: Fresh synthetic threads and fixture processes
features.offering: Ephemeral thread metadata is readable without a turn. The newer core reports paginated history, the older core legacy history. A second thread creates a fresh synthetic MCP process with value/version 0.
features.evidence: observed-working empty-thread metadata and process-scoped fixture state; durable storage untested
features.limits: The fixture stores state only in memory. Neither widget persistence, cross-session business storage nor existing user conversation history was tested or read.

features.surface: Plugin UI frontend; separate from app-server requests
features.offering: The OpenAI UI guide documents iframe-based inline, fullscreen and picture-in-picture experiences; extensions document sidebar apps, conversation panels, file viewers and composer entry points in their stated ChatGPT scope.
features.evidence: documented frontend offerings; current-study placement and canvas paint untested
features.limits: Do not transfer these UI capabilities to the CLI TUI or IDE merely because they share a model/backend. A custom frontend is one available route, not the only possible dashboard route.

features.surface: Generated protocol methods
features.offering: Both cores expose realtime start/appendAudio/appendText/appendSpeech/stop and voice-list method names.
features.evidence: observed-working schema inventory; realtime service and media UI untested
features.limits: Method presence does not establish audio model entitlement, recording consent, playback, video support or a plugin media player.

features.surface: Installed help and current official app-server documentation
features.offering: Stdio is tested. Help also exposes TCP WebSocket and Unix-socket listeners plus non-loopback authentication options; docs mark the WebSocket route experimental and unsupported.
features.evidence: observed-working stdio; documented and inventoried other listeners
features.limits: No remote listener, bearer-token setup or external deployment was performed. These app-server transports differ from MCP Streamable HTTP configuration.

features.surface: Earlier ChatGPT Windows desktop Codex-mode direct MCP session
features.offering: An existing local report records a real XY chart painted inside the native app tool component after direct MCP Save and Restart.
features.evidence: observed-working attributed historical frontend evidence; not newly reproduced by this backend study
features.limits: The earlier report bounds the app to its observed 26.1016.6573.0 package and distinguishes failed folder-plugin server discovery from the successful direct-MCP workaround. Fresh 26.1021.3705.0 paint and component controls remain the root task's separate check.

recommended_canonical_deltas: Pin npm CLI, desktop package and bundled core separately; do not generalize the old 0.145.0 backend to current desktop.
Withdraw the old uninstrumented claim that the executing thread connection omitted openai/form; current PID-correlated evidence shows the tool-serving process advertises it when opted in.
Keep both invalid nested-schema outcomes and make code-specific assertions version-aware; distinguish -32601 from -32602 rather than calling MCP unsupported.
Add observed backend transport of valid WAV, CSV resource links and embedded SVG without promoting it to playback, download or native paint.
Record standard typed forms and accept/decline/cancel as callback evidence; valid rich image-picker rendering remains untested.
Separate documented IDE plugin-bundle exclusion from supported IDE MCP configuration.
Attribute the earlier real desktop direct-MCP paint success and its failed folder-plugin discovery; keep fresh current-package paint and host controls separate.
Treat zero forwarded progress events in direct tool calls as a route-specific observation, not universal absence of streamed tool status.
